params:

```{r}
#| label: settings
#| include: false

# ---- SETTINGS -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Folder with the results made by `dashboard/prepare-data.R` (relative to this file).
# It is set at the top of this file (`params`) or with `quarto render -P data_dir:...`
data_dir <- params$data_dir

# Colors
primary <- "#113b9f"
secondary <- "#d1495b"
ramp <- c("#0868ac", "#0ea8bd", "#44d699", "#f6d145", "#dc3220")

# Number of rows of the table of taxa
top_taxa <- 20
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

library(arrow)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(jsonlite)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = "grey35"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
)

# Reads a result. Returns NULL if the file does not exist, so a section can be skipped.
have <- function(name) file.exists(file.path(data_dir, paste0(name, ".parquet")))
read <- function(name) {
  if (!have(name)) return(NULL)
  as.data.frame(read_parquet(file.path(data_dir, paste0(name, ".parquet"))))
}

meta <- fromJSON(file.path(data_dir, "meta.json"))
stats <- read("basic_stats")

n <- function(x) format(round(x), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
```

# Area

```{r}
#| results: asis

cat("**", meta$title, "**\n\n", sep = "")
if (!is.null(meta$subtitle)) cat(meta$subtitle, "\n\n")

what <- c(
  sprintf("Records from %s to %s.", meta$date_start, meta$date_end),
  if (length(meta$taxa)) {
    sprintf("Taxa: %s.", paste(names(meta$taxa), sapply(meta$taxa, paste, collapse = ", "), sep = " = ", collapse = "; "))
  },
  if (!is.null(meta$resolution)) sprintf("Maps use H3 cells of resolution %s.", meta$resolution),
  sprintf("Data prepared on %s.", meta$generated)
)
cat(paste(what, collapse = " "), "\n")
```

Counts of records and species show where and when people sampled, not only where
species live. Read the maps and curves together with the sampling charts.

# Overview

```{r}
#| label: overview

if (!is.null(stats)) {
  s <- stats[1, ]
  tab <- data.frame(
    Measure = c("Records", "Species", "Genera", "Families", "Orders", "Classes", "Phyla",
                "Datasets", "Years covered",
                "Threatened species (CR, EN, VU)", "Species with a single record"),
    Value = c(n(s$n_records), n(s$n_species), n(s$n_genus), n(s$n_family), n(s$n_order),
              n(s$n_class), n(s$n_phylum), n(s$n_datasets),
              paste0(s$min_year, "–", s$max_year),
              n(s$n_species_cr + s$n_species_en + s$n_species_vu),
              paste0(n(s$n_species_single_record), " (", round(100 * s$n_species_single_record / s$n_species), "%)"))
  )
  kable(tab, align = c("l", "r"))
}
```

# Where the records are

```{r}
#| label: map
#| fig-height: 4.2

cells <- read("cells")

if (!is.null(cells)) {
  world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

  # Polygons of the H3 cells if the h3jsr package is available, else the cell centers
  polygons <- tryCatch({
    pols <- h3jsr::cell_to_polygon(unique(cells$cell), simple = FALSE)
    merge(pols, cells, by.x = "h3_address", by.y = "cell")
  }, error = function(e) NULL)

  plot_map <- function(column, label) {
    # Log scale: cells with 0 cannot be drawn
    shown <- filter(cells, .data[[column]] > 0)
    if (!is.null(polygons)) polygons <- filter(polygons, .data[[column]] > 0)
    p <- ggplot() +
      geom_sf(data = world, fill = "#f1f3f6", colour = "#9aa5b1", linewidth = 0.1)
    if (!is.null(polygons)) {
      p <- p + geom_sf(data = polygons, aes(fill = .data[[column]]), colour = NA)
    } else {
      p <- p + geom_point(data = shown, aes(x, y, colour = .data[[column]]), shape = 15, size = 0.8)
    }
    scale <- if (is.null(polygons)) scale_colour_gradientn else scale_fill_gradientn
    p +
      scale(colours = ramp, trans = "log10", labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale()), name = label) +
      coord_sf(xlim = range(cells$x) + c(-2, 2), ylim = range(cells$y) + c(-2, 2), expand = FALSE) +
      theme(legend.position = "right", legend.key.height = unit(1.2, "cm"),
            panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#e8ecf0", colour = NA))
  }

  plot_map("n_records", "Records")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: map-species
#| fig-height: 4.2

if (!is.null(cells)) plot_map("n_species", "Species")
```

```{r}
#| label: sampling
#| fig-height: 2.4

hist <- read("cell_histogram")
if (!is.null(hist)) {
  hist$bin <- factor(hist$bin, levels = c("1", "100", "1,000", "10,000", ">10,000"))
  ggplot(hist, aes(bin, cells)) +
    geom_col(fill = primary, width = 0.7) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
    labs(x = "Records in the cell", y = "Cells", title = "Sampling effort across cells",
         subtitle = "Number of cells by number of records")
}
```

# Through time

```{r}
#| label: by-year
#| fig-height: 2.8

by_year <- read("records_by_year")
if (!is.null(by_year)) {
  ggplot(by_year, aes(date_year, n_records)) +
    geom_col(fill = primary, width = 0.9) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Records", title = "Records by year")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: by-month
#| fig-height: 2.6

by_month <- read("records_by_month")
if (!is.null(by_month)) {
  ggplot(by_month, aes(month, n_records)) +
    geom_col(fill = primary, width = 0.75) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.abb) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Records", title = "Records by month",
         subtitle = "All years together: shows when sampling happens")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cumulative
#| fig-height: 3.2

cumulative <- read("cumulative_species")
if (!is.null(cumulative)) {
  ggplot(cumulative, aes(first_year, cumulative_species)) +
    geom_step(colour = primary, linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Species", title = "Species accumulation",
         subtitle = "Cumulative number of species by the year of their first record")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: cumulative-phylum
#| fig-height: 3.2

by_phylum <- read("cumulative_species_phylum")
if (!is.null(by_phylum)) {
  top <- by_phylum |>
    group_by(phylum) |>
    summarise(total = max(cumulative_species)) |>
    slice_max(total, n = 6) |>
    pull(phylum)

  ggplot(filter(by_phylum, phylum %in% top),
         aes(first_year, cumulative_species, colour = factor(phylum, levels = top))) +
    geom_step(linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(primary, secondary, "#2a9d8f", "#e9c46a", "#8d5fd3", "#f4a261"), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Species", title = "Species accumulation by phylum",
         subtitle = "The six phyla with most species")
}
```

# Taxonomy

```{r}
#| label: taxon-level
#| fig-height: 2.4

taxon_level <- read("taxon_level")
if (!is.null(taxon_level)) {
  taxon_level$higher_level <- factor(taxon_level$higher_level, levels = rev(taxon_level$higher_level))
  ggplot(taxon_level, aes(total_perc, higher_level)) +
    geom_col(fill = primary, width = 0.7) +
    labs(x = "Share of taxa (%)", y = NULL, title = "Taxonomic resolution",
         subtitle = "Level to which each distinct taxon is identified")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: species-list
#| results: asis

species <- read("species_list")
if (!is.null(species)) {
  top <- head(species, top_taxa)
  # Records identified only to a higher rank have no species name
  top$taxon <- ifelse(
    is.na(top$species),
    coalesce(top$genus, top$family, top$order, top$class, top$phylum, top$kingdom),
    paste0("_", top$species, "_")
  )
  tab <- data.frame(
    Taxon = top$taxon,
    Class = ifelse(is.na(top$class), "", top$class),
    `Red List` = ifelse(is.na(top$redlist_category), "", top$redlist_category),
    Records = n(top$n_records),
    Datasets = n(top$n_datasets),
    First = top$first_year,
    Last = top$last_year,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  cat(sprintf("**The %s most recorded taxa** (of %s)\n\n", top_taxa, n(nrow(species))))
  kable(tab, align = c("l", "l", "c", "r", "r", "r", "r"))
}
```

# Depth

```{r}
#| label: depth
#| fig-height: 2.4

coverage <- read("depth_coverage")
bands <- read("depth_bands")

if (!is.null(coverage)) {
  coverage$depth_coverage <- factor(coverage$depth_coverage, levels = rev(coverage$depth_coverage[order(coverage$total)]))
  ggplot(coverage, aes(total_perc, depth_coverage)) +
    geom_col(fill = primary, width = 0.7) +
    labs(x = "Share of records (%)", y = NULL, title = "Depth information",
         subtitle = "Records with a minimum depth, a maximum depth, both or none")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: depth-bands
#| fig-height: 2.8

if (!is.null(bands)) {
  bands$depth_band <- factor(bands$depth_band, levels = bands$depth_band)
  bands |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(c(n_records, n_species), names_to = "what", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(what = recode(what, n_records = "Records", n_species = "Species")) |>
    ggplot(aes(depth_band, value, fill = what)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Records = primary, Species = secondary), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_number(scale_cut = cut_short_scale())) +
    labs(x = "Depth band (m)", y = NULL, title = "Records and species by depth band",
         subtitle = "Number of records and of species in each depth band")
}
```

# Datasets

```{r}
#| label: datasets
#| fig-height: 2.4

ext <- read("datasets_by_extension")
if (!is.null(ext)) {
  ext$type <- factor(ext$type, levels = rev(ext$type[order(ext$total)]))
  ggplot(ext, aes(total, type)) +
    geom_col(fill = primary, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(total_perc), "%")), hjust = -0.2, size = 3, colour = "grey30") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(x = "Datasets", y = NULL, title = "Datasets by data type",
         subtitle = "eMoF: extended measurements or facts; DNA: DNA derived data")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: published
#| fig-height: 2.8

published <- read("published_by_year")
if (!is.null(published)) {
  ggplot(published, aes(year)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = n_datasets), fill = primary, width = 0.8) +
    geom_line(aes(y = cumulative_datasets), colour = secondary, linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) unique(floor(pretty(x)))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = function(x) unique(floor(pretty(x)))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Datasets", title = "Datasets by publication year",
         subtitle = "Bars: new datasets. Line: cumulative number")
}
```

# Information metrics

These metrics count unique combinations instead of records, so a few intensively
sampled places do not dominate the result.

```{r}
#| label: year-information
#| fig-height: 2.8

yi <- read("year_information")
if (!is.null(yi)) {
  ggplot(yi, aes(year, i_p)) +
    geom_area(fill = primary, alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_line(colour = primary, linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Combinations", title = "Year information",
         subtitle = sprintf("Unique combinations of cell and %s in each observation year", meta$information_rank))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: publication-information
#| fig-height: 2.8

pi <- read("publication_information")
if (!is.null(pi)) {
  ggplot(pi, aes(year, i_p)) +
    geom_col(fill = primary, width = 0.8) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Combinations", title = "Publication information",
         subtitle = sprintf("Unique combinations of cell, observation year and %s among the records published each year", meta$information_rank))
}
```

# About

Analysis made with the [abra](https://github.com/iobis/abra) R package on the OBIS open
data. Version of abra: `r meta$abra_version`.
